newsitem.title: FRANCE: Italian film director Ferreri dies in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Italian film director Ferreri dies in Paris.

text.p: Italian film director Marco Ferreri, whose films included the orgiastic "La Grande Bouffe", died on Friday in a Paris hospital of a heart attack. He was 69.
"The Italian cinema has lost one of its most original artists, one of its most personal authors," said Gilles Jacob, boss of the Cannes film festival.
"No one was more demanding nor more allegorical than he in giving the state of crisis of contemporary man," he said in a statement.
Ferreri's films included "Liza" and "La Grande Bouffe", a 1973 satire about wealthy people who literally eat and drink themselves to death.
